The entry gives only the opening, then 'وذكر الحديث بطوله'. Partial needs a refers_to chain with a whole wording, and no chain here has one, so both chains are labelled shared with the opening. 'وقال فيه فان المستشار مؤتمن' comes after the closing formula and is left out. 'هكذا حدثناه ابو اميه وهو لسياقته' names Abu Umayya, who is in both chains, so it does not make either chain lafz.

The only words after this chain are a description of Khuzayma ('الذي جعل النبي شهادته بشهاده رجلين'); the hadith this chain carries is cut off. Labelled own because the narrator-note rule covers only notes that end where 'أن رسول الله' begins. If such a description counts as a note on the narrator, the chain has no words and would be reference.

The words are given inside the collector's comment ('ورواه يونس عن الزهري ... وخزيمه الذي جعل النبي شهادته شهاده رجلين') before the full chain, which then ends 'عن ابن شهاب به'. No rule covers words placed before their chain. Labelled partial: 'رواه يونس عن الزهري' names al-Zuhri, so it points at the al-Zuhri chain 476992, and only a difference is quoted. Dataset: the chain ends at خزيمة بن ثابت, but the text never names Khuzayma as a narrator; his name appears only inside 'عماره بن خزيمه بن ثابت' and in the quoted words.
